quotes.text: The greatest act of love is to make things easier for the people who will grieve you.
My father passed suddenly. Everstead made an incredibly painful time so much more manageable.
quotes.author: Margaret T.

quotes.text: Planning isn't about expecting the worst. It's about protecting what you love most.
I set up Everstead so my children will never go through what we did when Mum passed. It took one afternoon.
quotes.author: David R.

quotes.text: The most thoughtful thing you can leave behind isn't money. It's a plan.
